prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Confirm Your Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your pet profile details below to finalize your new desktop companion.", "Ensure photo and name match your desired pet options before proceeding.", "Verified Adoption Profile"]
1: ["Explore Your Pet Experience Paths", "Take a moment to see how different paths shape your companion's personality and activities.", "You can customize specific pet traits in the next step.", "Continue to Selection"]
2: ["How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet anytime to hide, summon, or open conversation controls from your system tray.", "Controls remain available whenever the app is running.", "Got It, Finish Setup"]
3: ["Verifying Desktop Screen Permissions", "We are making sure your system settings allow your pet to walk freely on screen.", "If prompted, allow desktop overlay access.", "Verify & Continue"]
4: ["Sign In to Protect & Sync Your Pet", "Logging in ensures your pet data, customization, and progression stay saved even if you change devices.", "Use the same login provider to recover previous pets."]
5: ["Choose Your Starting Companion", "Select Pet Species"]
6: ["Pet Active on Desktop"]
7: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Pick a quick starter vibe for your pet. You can customize traits and habits at any point later!", "Start Choice"]
8: ["Already have a pet? Sign in with your original account method to automatically restore your pet."]
9: ["Building your pet assets and desktop interface..."]
